transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Rachel. This is Daniel Koh. We have our arranged discussion now. Is this still a convenient time to speak?

Hello, Daniel. It is, thank you. I have my investment records beside me. I'd prefer to keep the discussion focused, as I need to get back to the business afterwards.

Certainly. We can keep the portfolio discussion concise and deal with the administrative points here.

That would be helpful. Short updates are easier to review alongside my records than a long general overview. Before we get into the discussion, I have my identification details ready. My identification number is S four zero zero three five eight four U. My date of birth is the thirty-first of May nineteen sixty-one.

Thank you, Rachel. Your objective is regular income and a portfolio that depends less on equities, with enough time to tolerate fluctuations in bond valuations. That is the objective I am using for this recommendation. I recommend Harbor SGD Bond Fund because its bond exposure supports your income objective and reduces your portfolio's dependence on equities. Pooling the bond holdings also spreads exposure across issuers.

I'd like to hear the rest of your explanation before moving on to the paperwork.

With Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the market value of the bonds it holds and lower the fund's net asset value. Do you understand how rising interest rates could reduce the value of your investment in this fund?

Yes, I understand. If market interest rates rise, the fund's bond holdings can fall in value, reducing the value of my investment.

You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, although I prefer to avoid unnecessary volatility.

I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive future returns.

I have the relevant page open now. The investment I want to transact in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. Please use Singapore dollars for this transaction. The amount I want to commit to this transaction is 1,000,000. For context, my portfolio balance is 1,200,000 Singapore dollars; that is the overall balance, not the amount for this order.

Please take your time with the page. There is no need to rush while you are referring to your records.

The older statements are in the same folder, which is why I am checking the headings carefully. My records show a previous investment of 25,000 Singapore dollars. That is just a comparison with a past investment, not today's instruction. The quantity for this order is 2,000 units.

I have noted a quantity of 5,000 units.

Sorry, that quantity is not what I said. It should be 2,000 units. I want to buy the units. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 500 Singapore dollars per unit.

Thank you for catching my mistake. I will amend my note. For routine correspondence, would you prefer to continue using the secure inbox?

The secure inbox is convenient. I review personal banking correspondence separately from the business paperwork, and I would like to keep that arrangement. Please keep any covering message brief so I can find the relevant document easily.

I can keep the covering message concise. Before we finish, how has the gardening been going? You had mentioned taking an interest in it when we last spoke.

It has been a welcome change from sitting at a desk. I am still learning what grows well in the space, but I enjoy being outside without having to look at a screen. I try not to make it another project with deadlines.

That sounds like a pleasant break from running the business. I will let you return to your day. Thank you for your time, Rachel.

Thank you, Daniel. Goodbye.
